the applicant seeks quashing of the FIR being C.R. No.11210008211897 of 2021 registered with Sarthana Police Station, Surat for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323, 504 and 114 of Indian Penal Code and further proceedings arising thereof.

2. Heard learned advocate Mr.Krunal Shahi appearing for the petitioners, learned advocate Mr.Yash Mohta appearing for respondent No.2 and learned APP appearing for the respondent State.

sentences.text: It is the case where FIR has been lodged by the first informant against her husband and in-laws for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 114 of IPC.
Learned advocate Mr.Shahi appearing for the petitioners submits that settlement has been arrived at between the parties and now there is no disputes between the parties.
Upon above submissions, he submits to quash the FIR.
4. Learned advocate Mr.Mohta appearing for the first informant placing on record affidavit dated 28.02.2025 would confirm the submissions made by learned advocate Mr.Shahi.
He would submit that first informant does not want to proceed further in the matter as the parties have amicably settled their dispute.
The affidavit is taken on record.
5. Learned APP Mr.Manan Maheta in given facts and circumstances would submit to pass necessary orders.

6. Having heard learned advocates for both side and and having gone through the record, what could be noticed that the first informant has lodged the FIR against her husband and in- laws for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 114 of IPC.

The first informant who is present in the Court has placed on record her affidavit stating that now she has no grievance against her husband and in-laws and she has no objection if the impugned FIR is quashed as amicable settlement has been arrived at between the parties.
In the circumstances, putting the petitioners on trial would be a futile exercise.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13481/2021 ORDER DATED: 12/03/2025 undefined 7.
Relevant para of the affidavit of the first informant are as under :
"1. I am the respondent no.2 in the above present application and I am fully conversant with the facts and circumstances of the case and therefore I am filing the present affidavit.

I respectfully state and submit that have gone through the above-mentioned application and as the entire dispute is amicable settled with my husband and my in-laws therefore now there are no other grievances with them.

I further states that as the disputes and grievances of both of us have been amicably settled therefore, I do not wish to prosecute against any of the applicants / accused persons named in the present FIR lodged by me on 13/07/2021 before Sarthana Police-Station, Surat being FIR No.1121000821897 of 2021 for the offences punishable U/ s. 498(A), 323, 504, 114 of Indian Penal Code.
2. It is submitted that presently I am residing with my parents in Surat city.

My marriage was solemnized with Nirav [the present applicant no.1] on 03/12/2009, a daughter namely Veeha was born during our marriage and presently she is aged about 7 years and she is residing with me in Surat.
I have resolved all the dispute between both of us pursuant to the above referred FIR.

On 21/01/2025, both of us entered into an agreement for mutual separation or divorce with mutual consent and all conditions were mentioned in the above agreement are binding to both of us [the Nirav Mohanbhai Ladani vs State Of Gujarat on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174531129/
2 respondent no.2 and the present applicant as well].

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that on 21/01/2025 the present applicant has filed a family suit being Family Suit No. 49 of 2025 before the Ld. Family Court, Rajkot for divorce with mutual consent u/s 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act which is pending for final decree.
I further state that whatever conditions mentioned in the above Family Suit are binding to both of us [the respondent no.2 and the present applicant as well].

Annexed hereto mark as ANNEXURE-R1 [collyl are copy of an agreement dated 21/01/2025 for mutual separation or divorce with mutual consent along with copy of Family Suit No.49 of 2025 pending before the Ld. Family Court, Rajkot.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13481/2021 ORDER DATED: 12/03/2025 undefined 4. I have entered into compromise considering for our better future.

I say and submit that after filing the impugned FIR, I realized that the nature of hardships and inconvenience, socially and mentally, which will cause to both sides, if criminal proceedings continue and both the sides are subjected to rigors of criminal trial, then it will immensely affect our future prospects of better life.
5.

In the facts and circumstances as narrated above, I at my free will, wish and desire am stating on oath that I do not wish to prosecute the criminal proceedings with applicants/accused named in the FIR as the dispute has been amicably settled.
I state that FIR lodged by me on 13/07/2021 before Sarthana Police-Station Surat being FIR No.1121000821897 of 2021 for the offences punishable u/s.498(A), 323, 504, and 114 of Indian Penal Code.

Therefore, the present FIR, and all other proceedings arising out of it may be quashed in the interest of justice."
8.
In view of above, the petition is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R. No.11210008211897 of 2021 registered with Sarthana Police Station, Surat for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323, 504 and 114 of Indian Penal Code and further proceedings arising thereof are hereby quashed and set aside qua the petitioners herein.
Rule is made absolute.
Direct service is permitted.

(J. C. DOSHI, J) GAURAV J THAKER Nirav Mohanbhai Ladani vs State Of Gujarat on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174531129/
